LESSON: MYSELF

Grade: PP1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.1: Myself

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Myself. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is your name?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognize self, parents and siblings by names in order to the names of the members of their enhance self-identity family.
2. identify plants and flowers in their immediate Environment care for their immediate as part of Paramatma’s environment. -E.g. Plants and creation Flowers)
3. appreciate Paramatma’s creation through watering plants for continuity of life.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recognize self, parents and siblings by names in order to the names of the members of their enhance self-identity family.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognize self, parents and siblings by names in order to the names of the members of their enhance self-identity family. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. identify plants and flowers in their immediate Environment care for their immediate as part of Paramatma’s environment. -E.g. Plants and creation Flowers)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify plants and flowers in their immediate Environment care for their immediate as part of Paramatma’s environment. -E.g. Plants and creation Flowers). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate Paramatma’s creation through watering plants for continuity of life.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate Paramatma’s creation through watering plants for continuity of life. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Myself.
2. Explain Myself to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Myself.
4. Show that you can: recognize self, parents and siblings by names in order to the names of the members of their enhance self-identity family.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Myself. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What is your name?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. recognize self, parents and siblings by names in order to the names of the members of their enhance self-identity family.
2. identify plants and flowers in their immediate Environment care for their immediate as part of Paramatma’s environment. -E.g. Plants and creation Flowers)
3. appreciate Paramatma’s creation through watering plants for continuity of life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
